claim.quote: This allows the exclusion of the scalar cross-section above 4.8E-8 pb near 50 GeV/c^2 WIMP mass with 90% confidence. Combined with data from the first run, this result improves to 3.9E-8 pb.

key_value.note: Second-run scalar limit near 50 GeV/c^2 (3.9e-8 pb combined with the first run).
key_value.quote: above 4.8E-8 pb near 50 GeV/c^2 WIMP mass with 90% confidence

name: WIMP-nucleon cross-section results from the second science run of ZEPLIN-III

summary.plain: ZEPLIN-III's second and final run saw eight events consistent with background and again no dark matter, closing the ZEPLIN programme.
summary.technical: Raw fiducial exposure of 1,344 kg d over 319 days (June 2010 - May 2011); eight events in the 7-29 keV nuclear recoil signal acceptance region, compatible with background; scalar limit 4.8e-8 pb near 50 GeV/c^2 (3.9e-8 pb combined with the first run); WIMP-neutron spin-dependent limit 8.0e-3 pb.

title: WIMP-nucleon cross-section results from the second science run of ZEPLIN-III
why_it_matters: The abstract describes it as the conclusion of the ZEPLIN programme at Boulby.
